title: clickhouse schema-drift gate
acceptance: pnpm --filter api check:ch-schema-drift is a package script that exits non-zero when a table or column present in schema.generated.ts is missing from live system.columns or has a different type, and exits 0 when the snapshot matches

The parse and diff logic is pure, lives in apps/api/src/db/clickhouse/schema-drift.ts, and has unit tests covering: identical schemas clean, changed column type breaking, vanished column breaking, vanished table breaking, live-only added column non-breaking
The snapshot's tables, columns, and types are parsed from schema.generated.ts itself; the new code contains no hand-maintained list of table or column names

The entry script requires the same env vars as generate-ch-schema.mjs (CLICKHOUSE_HOST, CLICKHOUSE_USER, CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD), exits non-zero with a clear message when one is missing, and never passes credentials via argv
pnpm --filter api lint, pnpm --filter api typecheck, and pnpm --filter api test all pass
notes: Pilot phase for the harness (BACKLOG item: tune max_attempts / max_review_cycles from this retro — deliberately runs on config defaults). Motivated by the 2026-08-10 incident: an upstream RENAME TABLE swapped profile_snapshots for profile_snapshots_v4 with three column-type changes; both list endpoints 500'd while every unit test stayed green. ADR-005 gives the schema-types-as-safety context.
review_findings:
SHOULD_FIX:
- apps/api/src/db/clickhouse/schema-drift.ts:41 — normalizeType only collapses whitespace runs, so it cannot reconcile the multi-line type literals the phase notes single out. generate-ch-schema.mjs collapses `\s*\n\s*` to one space, turning DDL-formatted `Tuple(\n  a String,\n  b String\n)` into `Tuple( a String, b String )`, while system.columns returns `Tuple(a String, b String)` — normalized they still differ, so the gate reports false-positive breaking drift. Unreachable today (all 17 snapshot tables use only Nullable/LowCardinality scalars) but live the first time a nested Tuple/Map/Nested/AggregateFunction column enters the snapshot. Also strip whitespace adjacent to `(`, `)`, and `,` on both sides before comparing, and add a unit test for a collapsed multi-line literal.
- apps/api/scripts/check-ch-schema-drift.mjs:54 — try/finally with no catch: a wrong password, unreachable host, or missing grant on system.columns surfaces as a raw unhandled top-level-await rejection stack, not the clear operator message the env-var branch takes care to give. It still exits non-zero, so the gate fails closed, but the failure reads as a crash rather than a connection problem. Catch, console.error a one-line cause, and process.exit(1).
- apps/api/scripts/check-ch-schema-drift.mjs:45 — the `// Credentials come from env, never argv` comment is copied from generate-ch-schema.mjs, where it justifies a real execFileSync argv decision. This script never builds an argv, so the comment explains an absence — narration under the comment-discipline policy. Delete it; the createClient call below already shows only env reads.

BACKLOG_WORTHY:
- low — schema-drift.ts sits under src/ so tsconfig.build.json compiles it into production dist/ (confirmed via tsc --listFiles) though only a dev-time script imports it; decide whether dev-only pure modules belong outside the build rootDir
- low — describeFinding's missing_table branch has no formatDrift assertion, and the missing_column branch is asserted only by header count, not by its rendered line
- low — apps/api/eslint.config.mjs ignores scripts/ wholesale, so check-ch-schema-drift.mjs is unlinted (pre-existing, shared with generate-ch-schema.mjs); consider a flat-config block giving scripts/ untyped linting
